record.t: Was first elected in 2020 to represent Monroe County residents in the Indiana State Senate.

record.t: Authored a Senate bill that passed 49-0 and would allow long-acting reversible contraceptives to be transferred between Medicaid patients.
record.q: Sen. Shelli Yoder, who authored the Senate bill that passed 49-0, said Tuesday the proposal would allow long-acting reversible contraceptives, such as intrauterine devices, to be transferred between Medicaid patients.

record.t: Was a Senate sponsor of House Enrolled Act 1149, which the governor signed into law to create an online portal for Hoosier farmers.
record.q: The bill was sponsored by Sen. Jean Leising, Sen. Daryl Schmitt, Sen. Gary Byrne, Sen. Susan Glick, and Sen. Shelli Yoder.
